projects.title: Structured Intermediate Representations for LLM Code Generation
projects.org: Master Thesis, Technical University of Munich
projects.summary: Researched structured intermediate representations for improving LLM code generation accuracy, controllability, and reasoning.
details: Designed and evaluated a two-stage LLM code-generation pipeline (Problem -> IR -> Code) to improve reasoning, planning, and controllability.
Developed structured intermediate representations including YAML, Mermaid, pseudo-code, and a custom DSL to guide model outputs.
Compared different representation formats under controlled prompt settings and evaluation workflows.
Improved LLM code-generation performance by 12-14% on complex tasks while keeping prompt and token overhead controlled.
